draft.emotion: relaxed and unhurried, reflecting on the stretch of time after work
notes: 'La tarde' covers both English 'afternoon' and early 'evening', from noon until it gets dark (when 'la noche' begins).
In Mexico, 'en la tarde' is more common than 'por la tarde' for 'in the afternoon'; 'buenas tardes' means 'good afternoon/evening'.
